approvers: My tax adviser, the broker, the buyer's house bank, my staff (informally), spouse
reason: The terms are cleaner than most, but a free first meeting costs me nothing and my adviser can test them. I sell to whoever shows proof of funds and pays most, so I'd want to see this buyer against others before I get excited.
objection: No track record and no earlier sellers. A bank letter is good, but I need my adviser to verify it, and I still have 10% held back for a year and promises about staff that I'm not sure I care about as much as the top price.
instead: Run a broker process on nexxt-change or via my adviser, collect several offers and take the highest one with proven cash.
would_change_my_mind: A verified bank letter for the full price, a named parent or funder my adviser can vet, and an offer at or above the best competing bid with 100% paid at closing.
